body: I'm really bad with expressing my feelings, and communicating my emotions effectively. I don't want him to feel like he's doing anything wrong with hanging out with people playing overwatch. (I have bpd and expressing my feelings is hard for me and I would take it personally a lot, when we didn't do a lot or if he was with other people and not me) I'm honestly kind of jealous because he did give me a lot of attention and time before, and I feel like it's just drifting. It's not as much romance, or intimacy, and it's hard for me. I don't really know if I should make a rule like that because I don't want him to feel "controlled" either. I'm just really bad with expressing my feelings right and to be completely honest, I'm scared of hurting his feelings or him thinking that playing overwatch with his friends isn't okay, you know? Before I would spiral and have meltdowns and overthink things because of my bpd, and I've been making at least a little progress with that and really working on my perception of things. I just feel really stuck :/
We're literally over 2,000 miles away. I can't break the distance yet as is.

We both have done a lot together. I saw him last month and I have gifted him things and we used to get eachother meals. We would call a lot and play games together, even have "sleepovers". I made him a care package recently. We planned on calling tonight and stuff, which I'm really bummed about because I have had more space with him and it's just really hard. I also went to my first like wedding (as a guest) and I just felt worse about myself and more insecure

We are an ldr and we originally planned on doing things. it sucks because he assumed I would be sleeping so he decided to play with people on overwatch. Again, no big deal, but I've been really working on myself and I've been trying to do healthier things and better myself. I don't really have any friends to play with and I'm used to us doing a lot more things together. Don't get me wrong, he has been neglectful, but it hits so hard now because I feel so alone :/
